title: Will Beauty and Wellness Have More Space to Shine in a Revamped CVS?
summary: As the drugstore giant prepares to decouple its retail pharmacy and health care businesses, industry analysts assess the impact on beauty.

extraction.key_fact: CVS가 소매 약국과 헬스케어 사업을 분리할 준비를 하면서 업계가 뷰티에 미칠 영향을 따지고 있다.
extraction.key_fact_quote: As the drugstore giant prepares to decouple its retail pharmacy and health care businesses, industry analysts assess the impact on beauty.
